column3: NASB spells “Johanan.” “With himself in the covenant” is rendered “they entered into a covenant with him.”
“Went around in Judah” is rendered “went throughout Judah.”
NASB supplies “Jehoiada.”
“Gatekeepers of the thresholds” is rendered “gatekeepers.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Those who are serving of the Levites” is rendered “the ministering Levites”; “they are holiness” is rendered “they are holy,” and “duty” as “charge.”
“He will be put to death” is rendered “let him be killed”; NASB adds “Thus.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“The spears and the shields and the shields” is rendered “the spears and the large and small shields.”
“South” and “north” are rendered “right” and “left.” NASB supplies “man with.”
NASB supplies “gave him” with “the testimony.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“The officials” is rendered “the captains,” and “the trumpets” as “the trumpeters.”
“Sent out” is rendered “brought out,” and “officers of the army” as “who were appointed over the army.”
“Put hands to her” is rendered “seized her”; NASB supplies “when.” “The gate of the horses” is rendered “the Horse Gate.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.

“Oversights” is rendered “offices,” and “in the hand of the priests the Levites” as “under the authority of the Levitical priests.” “On the hands of David” is rendered “according to the order of David.”
“At the gates of the house” is rendered “of the house,” and “to any matter” as “in any way.” NASB supplies “enter.”
“In the middle of the upper gate” is rendered “through the upper gate.”
“At peace” is rendered “quiet.”
